name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🎧 Earpiece sound (Settings › Listening): Steady keeps your earpiece's microphone on, so Buddy answers sooner, and he's louder (+12, or pick your own while he talks).
✋ Talk over / interrupt Buddy: while he's asking or reading back, say stop, cancel, no, yes, save or next box on its own, and he stops and does it.
🔊 Say "louder" or "softer" any time to change how loud Buddy is in your earpiece.
🔕 Far fewer beeps: one when it's your turn to answer, none after every sentence, and the phone's own listening beeps kept quiet.
🏡 "Which apiary?" takes just the name, and a name heard a little off asks "Did you mean Test Creek Yard?", then remembers it.
🐝 Buddy says more himself, says less ("Queen marked blue."), and waits for the rest when you pause partway through "Treated hive 2…".
⚙️ Settings: "Go to a section…" at the top; pick the voice that says names and your notes; voice control starts off each time the app opens (or on, if you choose).
